steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: The Purge Order will commence in 22 hours. Attention all personnel, evacuate immediately, evacuate immediately.
Evacuation is a top priority; the Legion's convoy has been shuttling back and forth, taking other transport units with them along the route, seeking shelter from the storm within WhiteSands.
Ica is dashing around, distributing flyers, desperately trying to get the message out. The man spots him from afar and gets so furious that he gets up from the ground.

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: ...Why the heck is he still running all over the place! What the heck, even at this hour—

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh...
His shadow beneath his feet twitched, lifting him and tossing him into the car.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Come on, get in the car. The Legion will ensure your safe passage out of here.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'm all this place requires.

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: What? You cheeky brat, who do you think you are? I'm not a young whippersnapper; how dare you talk to me like that?

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: ...Hey, where do you think you're going? Mania's all over the place; where on earth are you headed?! Hey, are you out of your mind?!

steps.speaker: Dejected Refugee
steps.content: Tell me what you need, and I'll take care of it for you! Stay put!! Hey!!

Crache emerges from the underground tunnel and ascends to street level. Before her, the High Tower of the Second Black Ring reaches for the heavens, cutting the setting sun's glow in twain. A colossal shadow stretches over the tumultuous Syndicate district, obscuring her from view, while the wailing of the crowd fills the darkness.

This is the place where she spent her formative years. A land plunged into perpetual darkness, devoid of hope, a whirlpool of violence willingly embraced. Yet today, a cloak of shadows conceals all the past ugliness. Some remain silent, others panic, and a few simmer with hidden anger, but everyone stands impotent in the face of these forces.
The Corruptors surge forth from the maze, inundating the West District like an unstoppable tide. In the presence of the Black Ring, human strength amounts to nothing.

Only Crache, who dwells in the shadows for so long, is familiar with this sensation. She stands perfectly still in the darkness, and yet recalls the absurd words uttered by the person who insists there is a glimmer in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Since then, I've thought a lot. I've read your poems, your teaching materials, and seen how much you praise Syndicate. But still, I just can't convince myself to fully believe in all of it.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I've always lived in the shadows, never seen the kind of light you talk about. I know even you don't believe some of the things you say.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I don't think I got it wrong. Syndicate has just chosen to go down a path that's beyond saving.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: But now, I really regret it.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You're inciting a bunch of delusional fools to die!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Quit acting. If I had known your real motive, I never would have believed those lies.

She remembers that underground room filled with Raven's notebooks and the wrinkled investigation papers. That woman meticulously documented the backgrounds of every Homeless, dealt with numerous "grown-ups," and even compiled thick educational guides for each Homeless.

Dis language, math—wait, scratch that, math's been crossed out—science, history, home ec, gym, music, art, shop class, and even hands-on outside projects. Raye plays at being the teacher for all subjects.
No conflict, no animosity, no Rustfire beliefs. Each page bears only the word "future."

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: When this war is over, take the children back to class. After my mission ends, I won't need to travel anymore. I'll rebuild Syndicate Academy and teach you well.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Believe it or not, I didn't create the school to trick you into fighting. I want you to live and grow up in peace...

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: ...I want more people to see my adorable student.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I regret not taking action sooner, not talking to you earlier, not bringing more people together. Even if we ended up hurt and bleeding, if only I had done more—
[CG: A colossal bird explodes]

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Even if things turned out the same, I wouldn't be this full of regret.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's not the things I used to hate that I despise; it's myself, for doing nothing at all.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Let what's in the past rot. Syndicate is in such a dark place now, and I had no hope for anyone in the past to improve it. I'm still not counting on anyone.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: You told a lot of lies, but at least one thing you said was true. Whether I like it or not, the future's going to hit me hard...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: So, I am going to take action, and make it listen to me.

Crache remains motionless within the shadows, but beneath her feet, the immense shadow roars to life. Like waves cresting upon the sea, she is hoisted high, gazing down upon all that unfolds in the neighborhood, meticulously marking the positions of every Corruptor and refugee.
Subsequently, the colossal black shroud fragments into countless razor-edged blades, hurtling swiftly towards multiple battlegrounds, cutting down the Corruptors and shielding the civilians.
Before long, Crache's nose begins to bleed, and she, who has long avoided the world's gaze, has never before exerted herself so fiercely.
However, the sun is descending, and the shadows will soon be swallowed by the darkness once they reach their full extent. Time is running out, and this is the moment to take action.
—She doesn't have complete faith in her ability to turn the tide, but she has grown weary of regret.
Horo observes from a distance and lets out a murmur.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...She's got some guts.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It should be safe from here on. You guys go ahead, I'll stay.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: But, Horo...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Call me Commander!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The Legion Commander never flees from combat.
